A stamina-first bodyweight plan, with flexibility, balance and defending work. Keep every session comfortable and build gradually.

Affordable food ideas

Simple ways to add fuel with everyday low-cost foods.

  • Breakfast: pair an affordable staple with milk, eggs, peanut butter or oats when available.
  • Daytime: save dinner leftovers, or try a peanut-butter/egg sandwich or beans on toast if practical.
  • Dinner: stretch pasta, curry or stew with beans, lentils, soya or affordable vegetables. Keep rice, potatoes, pasta, bread or pap for training energy.
  • Keep favourites: add a fruit or vegetable when available; drink water. No special supplements needed.

These are options, not a strict diet. South African food guide · WHO activity guidance. Build stamina gradually; repeat a rank week or use the shorter jog option if needed.

MONDAY · 1 / 7
System rule: Quality before intensity. Stop or modify anything that causes pain. Shadow movements rehearse coordination, but cannot build real ball control or shooting accuracy. Keep Monday and Saturday easy around Sunday's match.
